key_insight: GeoDiv KAN combines geometry-dependent feature gating with built-in incompressibility to solve time-fractional Navier–Stokes equations on complex domains.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets geometry-aware flow prediction and CFD reconstruction, with applications to unsteady cylinder flow and turbulent U-bend flow.
method: Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov–Arnold network.
Geometry-dependent gating adapts features to domain shape.
Streamfunction formulation enforces incompressibility by construction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports higher predictive accuracy than PINN, PIKAN, RBF KAN, and DF RBFKAN on square, circular, and star-shaped benchmarks, plus applications to public cylinder-flow and U-bend RANS datasets.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative error or runtime results, leaving accuracy gains and computational scalability to be assessed.
paper_title: GeoDiv KAN Solver for Time Fractional Navier Stokes Equations on Complex Domains to Realistic CFD Reconstruction
